from scipy.sparse.linalg import spsolve
from scipy.optimize import curve_fit

x,y=d[:,0],d[:,1]
o=np.argsort(x); x=x[o]; y=y[o]

def als(y,lam=1e5,p=0.01,niter=10):
    L=len(y); D=sparse.diags([1,-2,1],[0,-1,-2],shape=(L,L-2)) if False else sparse.csc_matrix(np.diff(np.eye(L),2))
    w=np.ones(L)
    for i in range(niter):
        W=sparse.spdiags(w,0,L,L)
        Z=W+lam*(D.T@D)
